panels.description: MaxUnverifiedBytes / PieceLength = max pieces downloaded concurrently. Expected ~2 with 8MB limit and 4MB pieces, confirming hypothesis 1 (parallelism bottleneck).
panels.title: Max Concurrent Pieces (H1)

panels.description: Gap between prioritizer window and anacrolix reader readahead. Large gap means prioritizer sets pieces to high priority but reader won't request them. Confirms hypothesis 2.
panels.title: Readahead Gap (H2)

panels.description: Static config values exposed as metrics for Grafana context.
panels.title: Config: Buffer Sizes

panels.description: Piece length and total pieces per torrent. With MaxUnverifiedBytes=8MB and typical 4MB pieces, only 2 pieces can be in-flight simultaneously.
panels.title: Torrent Piece Info

panels.description: Ratio of redundant seeks (offset == current position) to total seeks. >90% confirms hypothesis 3: WebDAV ReadAt triggers unnecessary Seek calls. After the fix, redundant seeks are counted but skipped.
panels.title: Seek Redundancy Rate (H3)

panels.description: Priority update frequency by type. High 'seek' rate with low 'seek_debounced' = active churn. Should correlate with pieces_downgraded_total. Validates hypotheses 2 & 3.
panels.title: Priority Update Breakdown (H2/H3)

panels.description: File handle cache hit/miss/evict/grace operations. High evict rate during playback suggests cache thrashing.
panels.title: Cache Operations

panels.description: Heatmap of read durations. Extended buckets up to 300s reveal the true severity of stalls.
panels.title: Read Duration Heatmap

panels.description: p95 time spent in waitForFirstAccess waiting for peer connections. If this is minutes, idle torrent reactivation is the bottleneck.
panels.title: Activation Wait p95

panels.description: p95 time spent draining a timed-out read goroutine before the next read can proceed. High values mean cascading timeouts.
panels.title: Drain Wait p95

panels.description: Number of reads currently blocked waiting for piece data from the torrent engine.
panels.title: Blocked Reads

panels.description: p95 time from file open to first byte served. Bimodal distribution reveals cold-start vs steady-state behavior.
panels.title: First Byte Latency p95

panels.description: p95 end-to-end WebDAV GET request duration. Shows how long Infuse waits for each HTTP response.
panels.title: WebDAV GET Duration p95

panels.description: Concurrent WebDAV requests by method. Shows Infuse connection patterns — many simultaneous GETs may cause contention.
panels.title: WebDAV Requests In-Flight

panels.description: Bytes served per second by WebDAV method. Shows actual streaming throughput to Infuse.
panels.title: WebDAV Throughput
